passage.text: What will Bangkok look like in 2050?
passage.reading: ˈwʌt wɪl ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈlʊk laɪk ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti?

passage.text: Experts say the city will have to deal with two big problems: rising sea levels and traffic.
passage.reading: ˈɛkspɜːrts ˈseɪ ðə ˈsɪti wɪl ˈhæf tə ˈdiːl wɪð ˈtuː ˈbɪɡ ˈprɑːbləmz: ˈraɪzɪŋ ˈsiː ˈlɛvəlz ənd ˈtræfɪk.

passage.text: Some scientists believe that parts of Bangkok could be underwater by 2050 if nothing is done.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈsaɪəntɪsts bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈpɑːrts əv ˈbæŋkɑːk kʊd bi ˌʌndərˈwɔːtər baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti ɪf ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz ˈdʌn.

passage.text: These houses would rise and fall with the water, like boats.
passage.reading: ðiːz ˈhaʊzɪz wʊd ˈraɪz ənd ˈfɔːl wɪð ðə ˈwɔːtər, laɪk ˈboʊts.

passage.text: Architects have already built floating homes in some countries, such as the Netherlands.
passage.reading: ˈɑːrkɪtɛkts hæv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈbɪlt ˈfloʊtɪŋ ˈhoʊmz ɪn sʌm ˈkʌntriz, sʌtʃ əz ðə ˈnɛðərləndz.

passage.text: Bangkok also wants to become a smart city.
passage.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈwɑːnts tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈsmɑːrt ˈsɪti.

passage.text: In a smart city, computers control the traffic lights, and buildings use less energy.
passage.reading: ɪn ə ˈsmɑːrt ˈsɪti, kəmˈpjuːtərz kənˈtroʊl ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈlaɪts, ənd ˈbɪldɪŋz ˈjuːz ˈlɛs ˈɛnərdʒi.

passage.text: Drones might deliver packages, and flying cars might carry passengers over the traffic.
passage.reading: ˈdroʊnz maɪt dɪˈlɪvər ˈpækɪdʒɪz, ənd ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkɑːrz maɪt ˈkæri ˈpæsɪndʒərz ˈoʊvər ðə ˈtræfɪk.

passage.text: Several companies are already testing flying taxis.
passage.reading: ˈsɛvrəl ˈkʌmpəniz ər ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈtɛstɪŋ ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈtæksiz.

passage.text: But will these ideas really work?
passage.reading: bʌt wɪl ðiːz aɪˈdiːəz ˈriːli ˈwɜːrk?

passage.text: Some experts doubt that flying cars will ever be safe or cheap enough for everyone.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈɛkspɜːrts ˈdaʊt ðæt ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkɑːrz wɪl ˈɛvər bi ˈseɪf ɔːr ˈtʃiːp ɪˈnʌf fər ˈɛvriwʌn.

passage.text: They say a sustainable city needs simple things first: more trees, better public transportation and less waste.
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈseɪ ə səˈsteɪnəbəl ˈsɪti ˈniːdz ˈsɪmpəl ˈθɪŋz ˈfɜːrst: ˈmɔːr ˈtriːz, ˈbɛtər ˈpʌblɪk ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən ənd ˈlɛs ˈweɪst.

passage.text: What we do today will decide the future of Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈwʌt wiː ˈduː təˈdeɪ wɪl dɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈfjuːtʃər əv ˈbæŋkɑːk.
